title: FinFET — A Self-Aligned Double-Gate MOSFET Scalable to 20 nm
version: IEEE Transactions on Electron Devices 47(12), pp. 2320–2325, doi:10.1109/16.887014

passages.locator: Printed p. 2320, Introduction, Fig. 1 and Device Fabrication; p. 2325, references [9]–[11]
passages.note: The authors identify DELTA as a basis for the FinFET and explain that they reduced the vertical height to fabricate aligned side gates using a quasi-planar process. They cite the preceding project demonstration and the Hitachi work.
